About Me

The person behind the costume.

Janindu Alwis

4 years of experience

As an Implementation Engineer by profession and a creative enthusiast by passion, I began my cosplay journey in late 2023 as a complete beginner, starting with an unfinished costume and a simple idea.

Since then, what began as a small hobby has grown into a creative journey of exploring characters, concepts, costumes, photography, and self-expression. Throughout the years, I have experimented with several simple yet meaningful cosplay concepts, continuously learning and improving with every project.

This portfolio captures that journey, from my humble beginnings to the cosplays and concepts I create today.

Behind the Costumes

Every character you have seen here has a secret weapon.

The person behind the designs & the make

Every Legend Starts With Her Hands

Behind every hood, every blade and every battle-worn seam in this portfolio stands one extraordinary person: my mom. She is the mind behind the designs and the hands behind the making, turning a rough idea into a costume I can actually wear.

When I imagine a character, she helps me see how it can be built. From the first sketch to the final stitch she brings the same patience, creativity and heart to every piece, and that is how my characters step out of my imagination and into real life.

Characters are born in my head. They come alive in her hands.
